k_justification: The frozen backbone missed the F1 target, and it is unclear whether ResNet-18 or MobileNet fine-tuning wins under the 50 ms CPU constraint; three cheap short rounds settle it.

trials.hypothesis: Fine-tuning ResNet-18 head-first then layer4 adapts to fluorescence images.
Full fine-tuning of ResNet-18 at a lower learning rate beats partial unfreezing.
trials.expected_effect: Higher macro-F1 than partial unfreezing, at more overfitting risk.

trials.hypothesis: MobileNetV2 fine-tuning reaches similar F1 with more CPU latency headroom.
trials.expected_effect: macro-F1 within 0.01 of ResNet-18 at lower latency.
